verdict.rationale: Daytona offers VM sandboxes (dedicated Linux/Windows VM) alongside container sandboxes and network firewalling, suggesting some hardware-level isolation option, but there is no documented explicit statement of a microVM technology (e.g., Firecracker/gVisor) or a security/isolation whitepaper describing the boundary guarantees. Community evidence even raises skepticism about security transparency after the project went closed source, undermining confidence in a clearly documented isolation model.
